enclosingCorrection.baselineDefect: The quality-negative-fixtures command had a 360000ms outer timeout while required preflight and semantic tests each explicitly allowed 600000ms. Blind fivefold scaling leaves a 1800000ms outer timeout below 3000000ms inner tests.
enclosingCorrection.reason: Allow the longest 3000000ms inner test plus one finite 60000ms completion/output-drain allowance. 51 minutes is the minimum enclosing command bound under that allowance; 52 minutes is the next whole workflow minute strictly above it, replacing the otherwise insufficient 50 minutes.
enclosingCorrection.aggregateSemantics: Workflow and worker bounds are aggregate wall-clock ceilings, not reservations for every sequential child to consume its full limit. Preparation includes install and tool downloads/extraction within its 75-minute worker ceiling. Exhaustion still fails the original occurrence; a longer deadline does not authorize replay.

reviewPublication.wait: Only genuine absent exact-head status on an actual protected-main push may wait up to300s. PR/dispatch/foreign contexts, present holds, wrong publisher, malformed replies and API errors remain fail-fast. A response returning at or after the publication deadline cannot supply timely proof.
reviewPublication.operatorOrder: Root must prepare the bounded actual-M receipt/status cutover before eventual merge and publish promptly after joining exact actual M. Increasing the absence wait alone does not fix publication ordering. No new publisher, retry loop or native effect is introduced.
